Subject: CardioFlux CAIQ/SIG Q&A — proposed times and agenda

Hi Emma —

Thanks for sending the CAIQ over earlier. I reviewed the file briefly and think a 30–45 minute working session will help us triage high-impact gaps and align on owners for evidence collection. Proposed agenda:

- Quick intros (5 min)
- Walk through CardioFlux CAIQ top 12 questions by risk (15–20 min)
- Identify evidence owners and delivery windows (10 min)
- Next steps & SLA for evidence uploads (5 min)

I have availability (PST):
- Thu 15 Jan, 10:00–10:45
- Thu 15 Jan, 14:00–14:45
- Fri 16 Jan, 09:00–09:45

If none of those work, tell me a window that does and I’ll send a calendar invite. For prep, I’m attaching a CAIQ template we prefer (CAIQ-v4-template.xlsx) and our evidence matrix that maps the CAIQ items to owners (Redwood-evidence-matrix.csv). If you want us to pre-fill any low-risk rows ahead of the call, say so and we’ll take a pass.

Attachments: [Attachment: CAIQ-v4-template.xlsx (xlsx)], [Attachment: Redwood-evidence-matrix.csv (csv)]

Thanks — look forward to aligning.

Great — I’ve penciled in Thu 15 Jan, 14:00–14:45 PST and will send a calendar invite with a Zoom link. Quick answers to your prep items:

- SOC 2: We can share our most recent SOC 2 Type II report under an NDA/secure link. If you prefer, we can provide a redacted copy prior to the call and grant access to the full report afterward. I’ll loop in Marissa from Compliance on the distribution.
- Pre-fill: Yes — we will pre-fill low-risk CAIQ rows (encryption at rest/in transit, key management, and data residency fields) and upload that to the shared Drive ahead of the meeting.

Pre-call asks (please can CardioFlux confirm these by EOD Wed):
1) Primary point of contact for follow-ups (name/email)
2) Any specific regulatory requirements (e.g., HIPAA BAAs) beyond standard HITRUST/SOC2 that we should be aware of
3) If you require a full network architecture diagram in advance

I’ve dropped a shared folder link here for evidence artifacts and drafts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCq-example-Redwood-CardioFlux

I’m also attaching a short Precall-checklist (Precall-checklist.md) with deliverables and timelines.

Attachments: [Attachment: Precall-checklist.md (md)]

Jonas
